name: Grand Hyatt Scottsdale Resort
positioning: Desert resort near the base of the McDowell Mountains in Scottsdale's Gainey Ranch neighborhood, with a 2.5-acre water playground, Spa Avania and access to Gainey Ranch Golf Club
best_for: Families who want a large water playground with a waterslide and sandy beach entry
Golfers who want access to Gainey Ranch Golf Club
Groups wanting a casita with a rooftop deck and fireplace

facts.text: The resort is near the base of the McDowell Mountains, in the Gainey Ranch neighborhood.
The property was formerly known as Hyatt Regency Scottsdale Resort & Spa at Gainey Ranch and is the first Grand Hyatt hotel in Arizona.
Big movable glass walls in the lobby and on the back of the resort are usually kept open.
The water playground has a winding waterslide, a sandy beach entry, family-friendly pools and private cabanas.
Spa Avania has a Himalayan Salt Room and a full-service hair and nail salon.
Gainey Ranch Golf Club is available exclusively to private club members and guests of the resort.
Every guest room, in every room category, has a balcony or patio.
Mountain View king rooms have views of the McDowell Mountains from the balcony.
The Casita Suite sits along the resort's waterways and has a wood-burning fireplace.
The Casita Suite can be expanded into a four-bedroom configuration.
The resort's restaurants are under the direction of chef and James Beard-nominated cookbook author Richard Blais.
La Zozzona is a fine dining restaurant devoted to Italian American cuisine.

highlights.text: The resort has a 2.5-acre water playground.
Gainey Ranch Golf Club offers 27 holes of championship golf with views of the McDowell Mountains.
Spa Avania has an outdoor pool flanked by fountains and fireplaces, and a garden patio with a hot tub and cold plunge.
The Casita Suite's rooftop deck has views of the lake and golf course.
The resort is inspired by Frank Lloyd Wright, with open spaces that blend with the natural landscape.

considerations.text: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is 18 miles away.
WhataHotel notes resort fees and premium pricing for amenities.
